sql:
/*
===============================================================================
首周前四日核心 KPI、首日 cohort 留存与 LTV 对比。
繁体窗口由 2026-07-29~2026-08-01 控制；SG OBT1 从 2026-05-08 起取相同天数。
SG 同时输出“新加坡Android”和“新加坡全体(iOS+Android)”。充值口径：18 用汇率换算，13 用 pay_amount_usd。
===============================================================================
*/
WITH Config AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' AS tc_start, DATE '2026-08-01' AS tc_end,
         DATE '2026-05-08' AS sg_start
),
TCBlacklist AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" user_id FROM user_result_cluster_18
  WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')
),
SGBlacklist AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13
  WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')
),
SGCountry AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13
  WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'
),
SGAndroid AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13
  WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'
),
SGMembers AS (
  SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)' grp, c.user_id FROM SGCountry c
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '新加坡Android' grp, c.user_id FROM SGCountry c INNER JOIN SGAndroid a ON c.user_id=a.user_id
),
DailyBase AS (
  SELECT '繁体CBT' grp, DATE_DIFF('day', c.tc_start, CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)) day_n,
         CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE) stat_date, e."#account_id" account_id, e."$part_event" part_event,
         CASE WHEN e."$part_event"='charge' AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE)
              THEN TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE)/COALESCE(x.exchange,1) ELSE 0 END revenue_usd
  FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Config c
  LEFT JOIN TCBlacklist b ON e."#user_id"=b.user_id
  LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x ON e."$part_date"=x.ex_date AND e.pay_currency=x.currency
  WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.tc_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.tc_end AS VARCHAR) AND b.user_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.grp, DATE_DIFF('day', c.sg_start, CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)), CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE),
         e."#account_id", e."$part_event",
         CASE WHEN e."$part_event"='charge' AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE)
              THEN TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount_usd AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END
  FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Config c INNER JOIN SGMembers m ON e."#user_id"=m.user_id
  LEFT JOIN SGBlacklist b ON e."#user_id"=b.user_id
  WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.sg_start AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day', DATE_DIFF('day',c.tc_start,c.tc_end), c.sg_start) AS VARCHAR) AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
DailyKpi AS (
  SELECT grp, day_n, stat_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN part_event='new_role' THEN account_id END) new_roles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN part_event='login' THEN account_id END) dau,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN part_event='charge' AND revenue_usd>0 THEN account_id END) payers,
    SUM(revenue_usd) revenue_usd
  FROM DailyBase GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
D0Cohort AS (
  SELECT grp, account_id FROM DailyBase WHERE day_n=0 AND part_event='new_role' AND account_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2
),
Lifecycle AS (
  SELECT w.grp, w.day_n, w.stat_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.account_id) cohort_users,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.part_event='login' AND d.day_n=w.day_n THEN c.account_id END) retained_users,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.part_event='charge' AND d.revenue_usd>0 THEN c.account_id END) cumulative_payers,
    SUM(COALESCE(d.revenue_usd,0)) cumulative_revenue_usd
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT grp, day_n, stat_date FROM DailyBase) w
  INNER JOIN D0Cohort c ON c.grp=w.grp
  LEFT JOIN DailyBase d ON d.grp=w.grp AND d.account_id=c.account_id AND d.day_n BETWEEN 0 AND w.day_n
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT 'daily_kpi' AS "数据模块", grp AS "对比组", day_n AS "相对开服日", CAST(stat_date AS VARCHAR) AS "日期",
  new_roles AS "新增角色", dau AS "DAU", payers AS "付费人数", ROUND(revenue_usd,2) AS "收入USD",
  ROUND(100.0*payers/NULLIF(dau,0),2) AS "付费率(%)", ROUND(revenue_usd/NULLIF(dau,0),4) AS "ARPU_USD",
  CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "首日cohort人数", CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "留存人数", CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "留存率(%)",
  CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "累计付费人数", CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "LTV_USD"
FROM DailyKpi
UNION ALL
SELECT 'd0_lifecycle', grp, day_n, CAST(stat_date AS VARCHAR), NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,
  cohort_users, retained_users, ROUND(100.0*retained_users/NULLIF(cohort_users,0),2), cumulative_payers,
  ROUND(cumulative_revenue_usd/NULLIF(cohort_users,0),4)
FROM Lifecycle
ORDER BY 1,2,3;
